memberdef.definition: virtual void AGRemapCore::BaseResEdit< K, V, KeyHash, KeyEqual >::buildResModel

memberdef.name: buildResModel

para.verbatim:
embed:rst Builds the model for one resource **and stores it** :raw-html:`
` :raw-html:`
` The one place the concrete resource-edit classes genuinely differ: each builds a different kind of :cpp:class:`IniResource`. Storing is part of the same call rather than a separate step, because a built model is opaque to this class -- it is never read back :raw-html:`
` :raw-html:`
` The default builds a plain :cpp:class:`IniResource` from 'srcPath', ignoring 'fixedPath'

parameterdescription.para: The name for the type of resource
The file path to the original resource
The file path to the fixed resource. Empty for an edit that has no separate fixed path
The name of the mod to fix to
The assigned id for the source file (see getFileId)
The .ini file the resource is being built for
